 [Newsworks = Reporter Moon Byeong-do] On the 10th, news of first-anniversary events in the gaming industry was shared.
 NCSoft held the 'Aion 2 1st Anniversary' event and revealed update plans. Gen.G and Bilibili Gaming (BLG) will face off in the League of Legends World Championship finals, and Netmarble will showcase their upcoming title 'Pearl in Blue' at Comic Market C109.
 (Photo courtesy of =NC) 
 ◆ 'Aion 2' First Birthday Event 
 NCSoft held the 'AION2 1st Anniversary' event at the Yangjae aT Center and revealed its update plans.
 More than 10,000 users visited the event venue at NCSoft. On the 11th, Chapter 1’s second story, 'Chapter 1: The Boundary Between Light and Veil,' will be updated. The Eltenen and Morghaim Part 2 region has been expanded, with 20 new sealed dungeons and 20 new main quests added, and the maximum level increased from 50 to 55. Dungeons will change to a tiered system where the required stats and rewards increase with difficulty, from Expedition to Sanctuary, and a point-based guaranteed reward system will be introduced; in January, the 10-player Sanctuary 'Fortress of Ascension, Erek' will be released. On the same day, 'Housing' was also introduced, allowing players to permanently purchase a 1 million Kinara territory, decorate it, and invite up to 40 guests. You can claim items with a commemorative coupon until March 3 next year, and one free server transfer per account will be supported on November 18.
 (Photo courtesy of = Riot Games) 
 ◆ Gen.G vs BLG 'World Championship Finals' 
 In the League of Legends World Championship finals, LCK’s number one seed Gen.G will face LPL’s number two seed Bilibili Gaming (BLG).
 Riot Games announced that two teams secured their spots in the finals at the Knockout Stage quarterfinals and semifinals held in Alan, Texas. The final will be held at 4 a.m. KST on Sunday, November 15, at the Barclays Center in New York, USA. Gen.G defeated LCS representative Lion (LYON) 3-0 in the quarterfinals and LPL representative Invictus Gaming 3-0 in the semifinals. Under the name 'Zenji,' they reached the final for the first time in nine years. BLG defeated Dplus Kia 3-0 in the quarterfinals and then beat three-time consecutive champion T1 3-1 in the semifinals to stop T1's four-peat. Since neither team has ever won the World Championship, the winner will claim their first title since the club's founding. If Gen.G wins, it will be their fifth consecutive and 11th overall LCK title; if BLG wins, it will be the first LPL title in five years since EDG in 2021. The head-to-head record in international tournaments is tied at 2-2.
 (Photo courtesy of =Netmarble) 
 ◆ 'Pearl in Blue' Comic Market Entry 
 Netmarble will exhibit its upcoming title 'Pearl in Blue' at Comic Market C109, Japan's largest subculture event, held at Tokyo Big Sight from December 29 to 31.
 'Pearl in Blue' is a subculture collectible RPG first revealed at Tokyo Game Show 2026, combining an RPG experience with a romantic feel as if you were the protagonist of a romantic comedy anime. Netmarble will open an exclusive booth at Comic Market to showcase key characters, including four members of the organization 'Dark Knight,' weapon animations, and the game's world. Detailed information about on-site merchandise and booth setup will be released sequentially starting in December on 's official Japanese X account. 'Pearl in Blue' is being developed by Netmarble N2 and aims for a pre-release in Japan in 2027.
